title: Relative clauses advanced
note: reduced relatives, of which, whom, whose · thin shell night/2026-08-05

items.en: The man sitting by the window is my boss.
items.cz: Muž sedící u okna je můj šéf.
items.gap: The man ____ by the window is my boss.
accepts: The man sitting by the window is my boss.

items.en: The book written by her won a prize.
items.gap: The book ____ by her won a prize.
accepts: The book written by her won a prize.

items.en: This is the house whose roof collapsed.
items.cz: Tohle je dům, kterému se zřítila střecha.
items.gap: This is the house ____ roof collapsed.
accepts: This is the house whose roof collapsed.

items.en: The people with whom I work are friendly.
items.cz: Lidé, se kterými pracuji, jsou přátelští.
items.gap: The people with ____ I work are friendly.
accepts: The people with whom I work are friendly.

items.en: There are three reasons, two of which are important.
items.cz: Jsou tři důvody, z nichž dva jsou důležité.
items.gap: There are three reasons, two ____ which are important.
accepts: There are three reasons, two of which are important.

items.cz: Kdokoli se zájmem by se měl teď přihlásit.

items.en: The film, which was long, bored me.
items.cz: Film, který byl dlouhý, mě nudil.
items.gap: The film, ____ was long, bored me.
accepts: The film, which was long, bored me.

items.en: She is the only person that I trust.
items.gap: She is the only person ____ I trust.
accepts: She is the only person that I trust.

items.en: The tools needed are in the shed.
items.gap: The tools ____ are in the shed.
accepts: The tools needed are in the shed.

items.en: I met a woman whose brother is a doctor.
items.cz: Potkal jsem ženu, jejíž bratr je doktor.
items.gap: I met a woman ____ brother is a doctor.
accepts: I met a woman whose brother is a doctor.
